sources: User-supplied Gojek lockup SVG (provided with the build request)
note: gojek.io is blocked by the restricted build environment this demo was authored in, so the lockup shipped here is the SVG supplied with the build request. gojek-logo-dark.svg and mark.svg are recolours of that same geometry; favicon.svg reverses the mark out of a #00AA13 tile. Gojek's proprietary display typeface is not licensed for this demo — Plus Jakarta Sans stands in throughout.
